title.narrative: Fortalecimiento de la Inclusin Social y de Redes de Atencin Proredes Fortaleza
Program for Strengthening Social Inclusion and Healthcare Networks PROREDES Fortaleza

description.narrative: El objetivo general del Programa es promover la reduccin de la desigualdad social, mediante la implementacin de mecanismos y acciones que permitan el pleno desarrollo de la juventud de Fortaleza, favoreciendo especficamente a jvenes en situacin de riesgo y vulnerabilidad social, as como por medio de inversiones para garantizar la integralidad de la atencin sanitaria, mejorando el acceso a los servicios especializados de media y alta complejidad y la hospitalizacin de jvenes y sus familias.

The overall objective of the Program is to promote the reduction of social inequality, by implementing mechanisms and actions that contribute to the full development of the youth of Fortaleza, specifically favoring youth at risk and facing social vulnerability, as well as through investments to ensure the integrity of health care, improving access to specialized services for medium and high complexity and to hospitalization of youth and their families.
